method: Roll calls: every 2023-24 and 2025-26 Assembly/Senate floor roll call document (1,162) was downloaded from docs.legis.wisconsin.gov (/document/votes/<session>/<av|sv>NNNN -> /<session>/related/votes/<chamber>/<id>) and parsed; selected votes are listed below. Each roll call's name lists were verified to equal the official AYES/NAYS/NOT VOTING/PAIRED tallies. Surname labels (e.g. 'ANDERSON, C', 'SPEAKER'=Vos, truncated 'DASSLER-ALFHEI') resolved to persons via docs.legis.wisconsin.gov/<2023|2025>/legislators/<assembly|senate> rosters; all labels resolved uniquely. Vote codes: Y, N, NV (not voting), PY/PN (paired aye/nay). In members[].votes a missing roll-call key means the person was not a member of that chamber at that vote. Candidates matched to rosters by surname + first name/nickname. incumbent=true means the candidate currently holds this same chamber+district (2025-26 roster); sittingLegislator2025_26 flags sitting members running for a different seat (district numbers changed under the 2024 maps). Group lists fetched 2026-10-28; matched to ballot candidates by surname+district. LegiScan/Ballotpedia not used.
